title: Starting over is not starting from zero

scenes.say: Starting over is not starting from zero.
scenes.visual: a man standing at the edge of an empty gravel parking lot at dawn, pale gray light, quiet determined mood

scenes.say: You lost the job, the plan, or the people.
scenes.visual: an empty cardboard box on a kitchen table in a dim apartment, a single lamp glowing

scenes.say: But you did not lose what you learned getting there.
scenes.visual: a man flipping through a worn notebook at the same kitchen table, warm lamp light on the pages

scenes.say: Every mistake taught you something the next attempt will use.
scenes.visual: a man sketching plans on a sheet of paper, coffee mug beside him, early morning blue light at the window

scenes.say: So pick one thing and start again today.
scenes.visual: a man stepping out of an apartment building onto a quiet street at sunrise, seen from behind

scenes.say: Not loud, not perfect, just honest work.
scenes.visual: hands sweeping the floor of a small empty storefront, soft morning light through the glass

scenes.say: The second time, you build with your eyes open.
scenes.visual: the same gravel lot now with fresh wooden framing going up, golden late afternoon light, hopeful mood

scenes.say: Follow for more. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a man standing on a hill at sunset looking over the town, relaxed posture, seen from behind

caption: Starting over is not failure. You carry every lesson with you into the next attempt.
